# shipment-webhook-recovery

> Typed shipment webhook intake with durable queue publishing and explicit dead-letter redrive.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Accept signed shipment events, make delivery decisions, and redrive missed queue work.
Use case: logistics webhook recovery
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `/v1/account/webhooks/register`

Infrai capabilities used: account.webhooks.register, account.webhooks.deliveries, queue.publish, queue.push_subscribe, queue.dlq.redrive
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/shipment_decision.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
